reason: Sixteen methods retain the existing source-content maintenance lifecycle: capture/maintenance leases, exact live recovery claims, bounded candidate retirement, blob references and physical reclamation. The existing transaction now retires at most256 manifest rows/candidates while reading one identity at a time; no retained vector, changed trigger, second queue or new maintenance service is introduced. The private candidate phase consumes only that actual writer transaction and remaining row budget. Claim preservation, bounded empty-candidate progress, whole-page rollback after an earlier candidate and normal recovery suites support retention at this measured shape and ceiling. Growth requires renewed review.
